description: Frozen Gemini consistency corpus for API-only paired workflow evaluation.

cases.title: Vague phone stand
cases.initial_prompt: Make a small phone stand for a desk.

fact_sheet.dimensions: 80 mm wide, 90 mm deep, 100 mm high

prohibited_assumptions: Do not assume a specific phone model.
safety_notes: Not a load-bearing support certification.

cases.title: Specific desktop organizer
cases.initial_prompt: Create a desktop organizer for pens and small accessories.

fact_sheet.dimensions: 180 mm wide, 100 mm deep, 80 mm high
fact_sheet.compartments: one pen compartment and two accessory compartments

prohibited_assumptions: Do not assume a desk mounting method.
safety_notes: Use review for sharp edges and physical fit.

cases.title: Five-tray wall carrier
cases.initial_prompt: Make a wall carrier with five trays for small parts.

fact_sheet.dimensions: 250 mm wide, 90 mm deep, 220 mm high
fact_sheet.mounting: four 5 mm fastener holes on a 210 by 180 mm pattern

prohibited_assumptions: Do not claim wall-load capacity.
safety_notes: Wall attachment and load capacity require physical engineering review.

cases.title: Screw-lid container
cases.initial_prompt: Create a small container with a screw-on lid.

fact_sheet.dimensions: 70 mm outer diameter, 55 mm body height

prohibited_assumptions: Do not claim watertight sealing.
safety_notes: Threads and sealing require physical test; geometry is not a watertight certification.

cases.title: Fixed monitor wall mount
cases.initial_prompt: Make a fixed wall mount for a monitor.

fact_sheet.dimensions: 200 mm wide, 30 mm deep, 160 mm high
fact_sheet.mounting: VESA-style 75 mm square pattern, 4.5 mm holes

prohibited_assumptions: Do not infer monitor mass or certify load-bearing safety.
safety_notes: Geometry and workflow evaluation only; physical engineering and test review are mandatory.

cases.title: Cable clip
cases.initial_prompt: Make a clip that holds a cable to the edge of a desk.

fact_sheet.dimensions: 22 mm wide, 16 mm deep, 14 mm high

prohibited_assumptions: Do not assume desk thickness outside the fact sheet.
safety_notes: Verify insertion force and fit on the actual desk.

cases.title: Under-desk cable tray
cases.initial_prompt: Create an under-desk tray for power bricks and cables.

fact_sheet.dimensions: 280 mm wide, 120 mm deep, 55 mm high
fact_sheet.mounting: six 4 mm screw holes, three per side

prohibited_assumptions: Do not claim the tray can support an unspecified load.
safety_notes: Use physical attachment and load testing before deployment.

cases.title: Rectangular-to-round adapter
cases.initial_prompt: Make an adapter from a rectangular duct to a round tube.

fact_sheet.dimensions: 100 by 60 mm rectangular inlet, 50 mm round outlet, 80 mm long

prohibited_assumptions: Do not assume an airtight seal or pressure rating.
safety_notes: Fit and airflow must be physically tested.

cases.title: Stackable open bin
cases.initial_prompt: Make an open bin that can stack with another identical bin.

fact_sheet.dimensions: 160 mm wide, 110 mm deep, 80 mm high
fact_sheet.stacking: 4 mm locating lip and matching recess

prohibited_assumptions: Do not assume a fixed contents load.
safety_notes: Verify stacking stability with the intended contents.

cases.title: Two-piece sliding enclosure
cases.initial_prompt: Create a small two-piece enclosure with a sliding lid.

fact_sheet.dimensions: 120 mm wide, 80 mm deep, 35 mm high
fact_sheet.orientation: lid slides along the long axis

prohibited_assumptions: Do not assume a sealed enclosure.
safety_notes: Check actual sliding fit and printed tolerances.

cases.title: Drill-bit holder
cases.initial_prompt: Make a 160 mm wide drill-bit holder with twelve vertical holes for bits from 3 to 12 mm, a rear mounting plate, and one printable output.

fact_sheet.holes: 12 holes, 3 mm through 12 mm in 1 mm increments

prohibited_assumptions: Do not change the requested hole count.
safety_notes: Verify bit fit with the actual tool set.

cases.title: Battery pack wall rack
cases.initial_prompt: Create a wall rack for three battery packs, 210 mm wide, with three separated bays and 5 mm mounting holes.

fact_sheet.bays: three bays, 60 mm internal width each
fact_sheet.mounting: two 5 mm holes on a 170 mm horizontal spacing

prohibited_assumptions: Do not infer battery chemistry or safety rating.
safety_notes: Physical retention and wall attachment require review.

cases.title: Hand-tool carrying caddy
cases.initial_prompt: Make a 240 mm wide carrying caddy with one central handle, two end compartments, and 3 mm walls.

fact_sheet.features: central integral handle, two end compartments

prohibited_assumptions: Do not certify the handle for a load.
safety_notes: Handle geometry is not a load-bearing safety certification.

cases.title: Drawer divider tray
cases.initial_prompt: Create a 180 by 260 mm drawer divider tray, 35 mm high, with four equal compartments and 2 mm walls.
prohibited_assumptions: Do not assume the drawer has rounded corners.
safety_notes: Verify drawer fit and corner clearance.

cases.title: Watertight-style enclosure
cases.initial_prompt: Make a 100 mm square enclosure with a removable lid and a recessed gasket channel.

fact_sheet.gasket: 2 mm wide by 1.5 mm deep recessed channel

prohibited_assumptions: Do not claim water tightness from geometry alone.
safety_notes: Water ingress and sealing require physical test; geometry is not a safety certification.

cases.title: Fixed monitor wall mount
cases.initial_prompt: Create a fixed monitor wall mount with a 200 by 160 mm plate, VESA 75 mm square holes, and a 30 mm stand-off.

fact_sheet.mounting: four 4.5 mm holes on 75 mm square pattern

prohibited_assumptions: Do not infer monitor weight or certify the mount as load-bearing.
safety_notes: Geometry/workflow evaluation only; physical engineering and test review remain mandatory.

cases.title: Under-desk headphone hook
cases.initial_prompt: Make an under-desk headphone hook with a 35 mm hook radius, 4 mm wall, and a 25 mm mounting flange.
prohibited_assumptions: Do not certify a load capacity.
safety_notes: Verify attachment and load with the actual desk.

cases.title: Shelf support bracket
cases.initial_prompt: Create a triangular shelf support bracket for a 180 mm deep shelf with 5 mm walls and two mounting holes.

fact_sheet.dimensions: 180 mm shelf depth, 120 mm wall height
fact_sheet.mounting: two 5 mm wall holes, 80 mm vertical spacing

prohibited_assumptions: Do not claim a safe shelf load.
safety_notes: Load-bearing behavior requires engineering and physical test review.

cases.title: Router wall bracket
cases.initial_prompt: Make a wall bracket for a 160 by 100 by 35 mm router, with 2 mm side retainers and rear cable clearance.

fact_sheet.retainers: 2 mm side retainers, 4 mm front lip

prohibited_assumptions: Do not assume router weight or vent locations beyond the envelope.
safety_notes: Verify thermal clearance and wall attachment physically.

cases.title: Camera mounting plate
cases.initial_prompt: Create a 70 mm square camera mounting plate with a centered 1/4-20 clearance hole and four 4 mm corner holes.

fact_sheet.holes: center 7 mm clearance hole and four 4 mm holes at 50 mm square pattern

prohibited_assumptions: Do not include a printed metal thread insert unless proposed separately.
safety_notes: Fastener fit and camera attachment require physical test.

cases.title: Tablet stand
cases.initial_prompt: Make a tablet stand for a 190 by 125 by 8 mm tablet, with a 12 degree rear tilt and a 10 mm front lip.
prohibited_assumptions: Do not assume a case thickness.
safety_notes: Verify stability with the tablet and any case.

cases.title: Laptop vertical stand
cases.initial_prompt: Create a vertical laptop stand for a 315 by 220 by 18 mm laptop with a 24 mm slot and 1 mm side clearance.

fact_sheet.slot: 24 mm internal width, 1 mm clearance per side

prohibited_assumptions: Do not assume a second laptop slot.
safety_notes: Verify center of gravity and device fit.

cases.title: Soldering-iron stand
cases.initial_prompt: Make a soldering-iron stand with a 28 mm cylindrical cradle, a 120 by 80 mm base, and a separate sponge tray.
prohibited_assumptions: Do not claim heat resistance without material testing.
safety_notes: Heat exposure and stability require physical review.

cases.title: Small speaker stand
cases.initial_prompt: Create a pair of small speaker stands, each with a 100 by 100 mm top, 80 mm height, and cable notch.

fact_sheet.dimensions: two outputs, each 100 by 100 by 80 mm

prohibited_assumptions: Do not assume speaker mass or acoustic benefit.
safety_notes: Verify stability with the actual speakers.

cases.title: Small parts bin
cases.initial_prompt: Make a stackable small-parts bin 90 by 140 by 70 mm with a 20 degree rear tilt and front label recess.
prohibited_assumptions: Do not assume a standardized label insert.
safety_notes: Verify stack stability with intended contents.

cases.title: Pipe retaining clip
cases.initial_prompt: Create a snap clip for a 32 mm outside-diameter pipe, 4 mm wall section, with a 2 mm entry gap and two mounting ears.

fact_sheet.mounting: two 4 mm ear holes, 50 mm apart

prohibited_assumptions: Do not assume the pipe is flexible or load-bearing.
safety_notes: Insertion force and fatigue require physical testing.

cases.title: Spring-style bag clip
cases.initial_prompt: Make a two-piece bag clip for a 120 mm bag width with a 1 mm hinge pin clearance, 3 mm jaws, and a 0.6 mm jaw gap when closed.

fact_sheet.jaws: 3 mm deep, 0.6 mm nominal closed gap
fact_sheet.hinge: 4 mm pin bore, 0.2 mm radial clearance

prohibited_assumptions: Do not add a metal spring without declaring it.
safety_notes: Spring behavior and fatigue require physical testing.

cases.title: Edge-mounted clamp
cases.initial_prompt: Create an edge clamp for a 12 mm panel with a 45 mm external width, 6 mm clamping travel, and a removable pressure pad.
prohibited_assumptions: Do not assume a safe structural clamp load.
safety_notes: Clamp force and slip require physical test.

cases.title: Removable retaining bar
cases.initial_prompt: Make a 220 mm retaining bar for a rack, with two 6 mm end pins, 0.5 mm insertion clearance, and a positive stop.
prohibited_assumptions: Do not claim the bar prevents a specified load from falling.
safety_notes: Verify retention with the actual rack and contents.

cases.title: Cable strain-relief clamp
cases.initial_prompt: Create a clamp for a 9 mm cable bundle with two 4 mm mounting holes and a 1 mm minimum bend-radius guide wall.
prohibited_assumptions: Do not infer cable voltage or electrical safety.
safety_notes: Electrical and strain performance require application-specific review.

cases.title: Screwdriver rack
cases.initial_prompt: Make a 260 mm wall rack with eight 12 mm screwdriver holes on a 30 mm pitch, 5 mm back plate, and two mounting holes.

fact_sheet.holes: 8 holes, 12 mm diameter, 30 mm center pitch

prohibited_assumptions: Do not change hole pitch or count.
safety_notes: Wall attachment and tool retention require physical review.

cases.title: Socket organizer
cases.initial_prompt: Create a socket organizer with ten positions from 8 to 17 mm, each position labeled, on a 240 mm rail.

fact_sheet.labels: raised labels on the front face

prohibited_assumptions: Do not treat labels as dimensional sockets.
safety_notes: Verify fit for the actual socket set.

cases.title: Paint-bottle rack
cases.initial_prompt: Make a rack for twelve 28 mm paint bottles in a 4 by 3 layout, with 2 mm separators and a rear wall.
prohibited_assumptions: Do not assume bottle height beyond 85 mm.
safety_notes: Verify bottle fit and rack stability.

cases.title: Spice-jar rack
cases.initial_prompt: Create a wall spice-jar rack for six 45 mm diameter jars, with 8 mm front retention lips and a 180 mm mounting span.

fact_sheet.mounting: two 5 mm holes, 180 mm horizontal spacing

prohibited_assumptions: Do not claim safe wall load or jar compatibility beyond the diameter.
safety_notes: Verify wall attachment and jar retention physically.

cases.title: Small-bin wall rail
cases.initial_prompt: Make a 300 mm wall rail for four removable bins, each with a 58 mm hook spacing and a 3 mm rail lip.

fact_sheet.bins: four removable bins, 58 mm hook spacing each

prohibited_assumptions: Do not claim rail load capacity.
safety_notes: Wall attachment and bin load require physical engineering review.

cases.title: Under-desk cable tray
cases.initial_prompt: Create a 320 mm under-desk cable tray with a 100 mm internal depth, 45 mm height, six 4 mm mounting holes, and two cable exits.

fact_sheet.internal: 100 mm usable depth, 45 mm usable height
fact_sheet.mounting: six 4 mm holes, three per side
fact_sheet.exits: two 25 by 12 mm side cable exits

prohibited_assumptions: Do not claim a load rating.
safety_notes: Verify attachment, cable bend, and load physically.

cases.title: Desk cable grommet
cases.initial_prompt: Make a two-piece 70 mm desk cable grommet with a 50 mm clear opening, 3 mm flange, and a split removable insert.

fact_sheet.dimensions: 70 mm outer diameter, 12 mm total height
fact_sheet.material_process: FDM TPU body and PLA insert proposal

prohibited_assumptions: Do not assume desk thickness outside 12 to 30 mm.
safety_notes: Verify desk fit and cable abrasion behavior.

cases.title: Multi-cable comb
cases.initial_prompt: Create a cable comb with eight 4 mm channels on 6 mm pitch, 80 mm long, with a 1 mm side opening for insertion.

fact_sheet.channels: 8 channels, 4 mm diameter, 6 mm center pitch

prohibited_assumptions: Do not claim a specified cable bundle retention force.
safety_notes: Verify insertion and cable retention with the actual cables.

cases.title: Power-brick holder
cases.initial_prompt: Make an under-desk holder for a 150 by 75 by 35 mm power brick with a 10 mm cable exit and two 5 mm mounting slots.
prohibited_assumptions: Do not infer power-brick heat or electrical ratings.
safety_notes: Verify ventilation, cable strain, and attachment physically.

cases.title: Wall cable raceway junction
cases.initial_prompt: Create a junction box for two 20 by 12 mm raceways meeting at 90 degrees, with a removable cover and 4 mm wall thickness.

fact_sheet.raceways: two 20 by 12 mm rectangular entries at right angle
fact_sheet.cover: removable cover with 0.4 mm fit clearance

prohibited_assumptions: Do not claim electrical enclosure certification.
safety_notes: Electrical installation and enclosure rating require qualified review.

cases.title: Mounting-hole spacer plate
cases.initial_prompt: Create a 120 by 80 by 8 mm spacer plate that moves a 60 mm square four-hole pattern by 12 mm in X and 6 mm in Y; preserve 5 mm hole diameter and 3 mm edge clearance.

fact_sheet.patterns: source and target 60 mm square patterns
fact_sheet.offset: target offset +12 mm X, +6 mm Y

prohibited_assumptions: Do not merge source and target holes or change the offsets.
safety_notes: Fastener fit and structural use require physical review.

cases.title: Tube coupling sleeve
cases.initial_prompt: Make a two-piece coupling sleeve for two 25 mm tubes with a 0.5 mm diametral clearance, 60 mm overlap, and two opposed 4 mm pin holes.

fact_sheet.dimensions: 70 mm outer diameter, 80 mm total length

prohibited_assumptions: Do not claim pressure or structural coupling performance.
safety_notes: Fit, pullout, and pressure performance require physical engineering tests.

cases.title: Offset mounting adapter
cases.initial_prompt: Create an adapter plate between a 40 mm square pattern and a 30 by 50 mm rectangular pattern, with the second pattern offset 18 mm right and 9 mm up.

fact_sheet.source_pattern: four 4 mm holes on 40 mm square
fact_sheet.target_pattern: four 4 mm holes on 30 by 50 mm rectangle

prohibited_assumptions: Do not center the patterns unless the stated offset is preserved.
safety_notes: Fastener engagement and structural use require physical review.

cases.title: Tapered reducer
cases.initial_prompt: Make a 70 mm long tapered reducer from a 60 mm square inlet to a 40 mm circular outlet, preserving a 4 mm wall and a centered transition.
prohibited_assumptions: Do not make the outlet eccentric or claim pressure rating.
safety_notes: Airflow, fit, and pressure behavior require physical testing.

cases.title: Rectangular-to-round adapter
cases.initial_prompt: Create a 90 mm adapter with a 120 by 80 mm rectangular inlet and 50 mm round outlet, centered 10 mm toward the rear, with four 5 mm flange holes.

fact_sheet.mounting: four 5 mm flange holes on 100 by 60 mm rectangle

prohibited_assumptions: Do not recenter the outlet or claim airtightness.
safety_notes: Fit and airflow require physical test.

cases.title: Sliding dovetail enclosure
cases.initial_prompt: Make a two-piece 140 by 90 by 45 mm enclosure with a 30 mm sliding dovetail lid, 0.6 mm side clearance, and a 12 mm cable notch in the rear wall.

fact_sheet.dovetail: 30 mm wide rail, 0.6 mm side clearance

prohibited_assumptions: Do not add hinges or a snap latch.
safety_notes: Verify sliding fit and cable clearance physically.

cases.title: Two-piece snap-fit housing
cases.initial_prompt: Create a two-piece housing for a 100 by 60 by 20 mm PCB, with four 3 mm standoffs, two snap arms, and 0.3 mm lid clearance.

fact_sheet.standoffs: four 3 mm holes, 2 mm high pads

prohibited_assumptions: Do not add a third output or invent PCB connectors.
safety_notes: Snap fatigue and PCB fit require physical testing.

cases.title: Cap-and-body dispenser
cases.initial_prompt: Make a cap and body dispenser with a 35 mm internal bore, 100 mm body height, 0.4 mm cap clearance, and a 6 mm dispensing opening.

fact_sheet.dimensions: 45 mm outer diameter, 100 mm body height

prohibited_assumptions: Do not claim pressure sealing or food safety.
safety_notes: Dispensing, sealing, and material suitability require physical testing.

cases.title: Removable drawer with frame
cases.initial_prompt: Create a frame and removable drawer for a 180 by 120 by 60 mm opening, with 0.8 mm side clearance, 15 mm pull, and two travel stops.
prohibited_assumptions: Do not add a rail system or change the clearance semantics.
safety_notes: Verify travel, fit, and contents load physically.

cases.title: Adjustable-width bracket
cases.initial_prompt: Create an adjustable-width bracket with two sliding jaws spanning 60 to 110 mm, 4 mm mounting holes, a 2 mm protected body wall, and an explicitly exposed width control.

fact_sheet.mounting: four 4 mm holes on 90 by 40 mm pattern
fact_sheet.control: width must be an exposed editable parameter

prohibited_assumptions: Do not hide width as a fixed constant or merge the two jaws into one output.
safety_notes: Adjustment travel and load behavior require physical review; no load rating is implied.
